faq_heading: Homes near Walnut Road Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Walnut Road Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Walnut Road Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Walnut Road Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Walnut Road Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 120 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,365,000, townhomes $780,000, condos $472,450. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Walnut Road Elementary?
faq.a: Near Walnut Road Elementary (1 km), homes took a median 19 days to sell and closed at 97.7% of the list price, with 8% over asking, across 120 sales.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Walnut Road Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are William Watson Elementary (0.7 km south-east), Frost Road Elementary (0.8 km north) and Coyote Creek Elementary (1.2 km west).

Walnut Road Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 16152 82 Ave. It teaches grades K to 7.
The search below lists homes for sale whose listing names Walnut Road Elementary. Under it are the prices homes sold for within 1 km of the school.
How the Walnut Road Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Walnut Road Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Walnut Road Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 120 homes sold within 1 km of Walnut Road Elementary: 23 houses, 80 townhomes and 16 condos. The largest group was townhomes, at a median of $780,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Walnut Road Elementary

15 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Walnut Road Elementary in a straight line (10 elementary, 3 secondary, 2 other; 5 independent). The closest is William Watson Elementary, 0.7 km away, and the farthest on this list is Cornerstone Montessori School, 3.0 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Fleetwood Park Secondary (1.3 km); the nearest independent school is Holy Cross Regional High School (1.3 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Frost Road Elementary (0.8 km). Other elementary schools close by: William Watson Elementary (0.7 km south-east), Frost Road Elementary (0.8 km north), Coyote Creek Elementary (1.2 km west), Coast Meridian Elementary (1.4 km east), St Matthew's Elementary (1.4 km north). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is William Watson Elementary, 0.7 km south-east of Walnut Road Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Walnut Road Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from Walnut Road Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Walnut Road Elementary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median townhome within 1 km of Walnut Road Elementary was $780,000, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
Look at William Watson Elementary, the nearest other elementary school, 0.7 km south-east of Walnut Road Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
